name: Step 2 -- Re-entry Lag Fix (EXPERIMENT, not a deliverable)
description: Isolates the effect of loosening the CASH->BULL_FULL re-entry condition from 'all 4 signals must clear simultaneously' to 'at least N of 4'. Exit side (kill switch) is untouched -- unlike step2_killfix_variant.json, which tested the exit side and failed the sealed holdout. Every other parameter held fixed at the already-recommended 'confirmed values locked' tuned config. Lives outside strategies/*.json on purpose -- not a deliverable strategy.

cooldown.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (2), not re-searched here.

defSell.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (75), not re-searched here.

rsiPeriod.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (24), not re-searched here.

rsiTrim.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (50), not re-searched here.

uproSplit.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (10), not re-searched here.

reentryMinConditions.tier_note: NEW. Re-entry from CASH fires once at least this many of {SPY>200SMA, VIX<threshold, SPY>50SMA, QQQ>50SMA} are true, instead of requiring all 4. 4 = today's behavior (no change).
